prompt:
Design a production-quality mobile audiobook player UI mockup for Xandrio. Render ONE flat portrait screen, aspect 393:852, no device bezel, no perspective, no surrounding presentation. This is a functional phone app screen, not a poster. Extremely clean modern precise UI. Dark charcoal background #151515, ivory text, muted warm gray secondary text readable at 4.5:1, single restrained amber progress accent. Inter-style sober UI typography. Use the attached screenshot ONLY for the real book cover/content, discard its layout. The Body Electric by Robert Becker. Preserve the portrait cover art with black background, anatomy figures and white BODY ELECTRIC lettering. The actual visible portrait artwork must be LARGE around 210px wide and 310px tall relative to 393px screen, no square padded container, no cropped art. All touch areas >=44px. Keep precise spacing. Functional content: Back, study guide icon, pronunciation icon, title and author, chapter 'Undercurrents in Neurology', chapter list icon, compact Chapter/Book seek scope, thin amber elapsed scrubber on visible gray track with 8:43 and 13:40, previous chapter, skip back 15, large ivory circular pause, skip forward 15, next chapter, subtle book completion '16% · 7h 55m left', Sleep, Bookmark, 1.25× Speed, subtle changeable narrator 'Kokoro Onyx' with 'Ready', and About this book disclosure. No added claims, no glowing backdrop, no cards around each region, no excessive rules. Simulate small iOS status bar top and home indicator bottom with safe area. Retain every function, with primary controls above fold.
COMPOSITION A: large centered portrait cover directly below slim toolbar; left-aligned title 24px and author below cover, then chapter row and timeline, then generously spaced five-button transport. Secondary utility row then small narrator footer and About disclosure. Art is the focal point, controls tightly composed. No top eyebrow labels. Fit all within phone height by eliminating redundant vertical padding.
